chunks.arabic_text: مَعَانِي الْأَخْبَارِ: عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ أَبَانَ الْأَحْمَرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Ma'ani al-Akhbar: From his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban al-Ahmar, from Abdallah ibn Sinan who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ أَوْصَتْ بِثُلُثِهَا يُقْضَى بِهِ دَيْنُ ابْنِ أُخْتِهَا وَجُزْءٌ مِنْهُ لِفُلَانٍ وَفُلَانَةً، فَلَمْ أَعْرِفْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَدَّمَانِي إِلَى ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَقَالَ: لَيْسَ لَهُمَا شَيْءٌ، فَقَالَ: كَذَبَ وَاللَّه، لَهُمَا الْعَشْرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ

translations.en: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a woman who willed one-third of her estate to be used to pay the debt of her brother's son, and a portion of it for a certain man and a certain woman. I did not know what that portion was. They brought me to Ibn Abi Layla, who said: They are to be given nothing. He (the Imam) said: He has lied by Allah! They are to be given one-tenth of the one-third.

en.summary: This hadith highlights the jurisprudential distinction between debt repayment and bequests (wasiyyah) within the one-third limit, where the Imam corrects the judge Ibn Abi Layla by affirming the relatives' right to one-tenth of the allocated third. It underscores the Shia emphasis on precise calculation of shares, ensuring that specific beneficiaries receive their due portion before the remainder is distributed, reflecting the broader principles of inheritance law.
en.seo_question: What is the share of relatives in a bequest when a debt is also paid from the same third?
